skill.name: ai-music
skill.description: Generate or edit AI music on RunComfy using the runcomfy CLI with guided routing for ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, audio-inpaint, and audio-outpaint.
skill.summary: Create, repair, or extend AI music tracks through RunComfy model endpoints.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Static findings are mostly false positives from Markdown backticks, documentation links, and explicit RunComfy CLI examples. The skill has real but disclosed network behavior because it submits prompts and optional audio URLs to RunComfy; no prompt injection, secret exfiltration, arbitrary command execution, or hidden malicious filesystem access was found.

remediation.issue: External audio URLs are untrusted inputs for edit workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the current guidance that agents should only use audio URLs supplied by the user for the current task, and ask before processing unfamiliar links.

remediation.issue: RunComfy authentication creates a local token file.
remediation.suggestion: Continue documenting the token path, permissions, and RUNCOMFY_TOKEN alternative so users can choose appropriate storage for local or CI use.

content.value_statement: Creating usable AI music often requires choosing between several models and endpoint schemas. This skill routes requests to the right RunComfy music workflow and provides concise CLI commands.
actual_capabilities: Routes new music requests to ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, or ACE Step 1.5 based on quality, cost, vocals, and language needs.
Provides RunComfy CLI commands for text-to-music generation with model-specific input fields.
Guides time-bounded audio-inpaint edits for replacing a section of an existing track.
Guides audio-outpaint edits for extending tracks before, after, or in both directions.
Documents practical patterns for jingles, game loops, multilingual songs, theme music, and draft-to-polish workflows.
Explains authentication, output directories, exit codes, cost tradeoffs, and safe handling of tokens and audio URLs.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or API token.
Generated quality, duration limits, and pricing depend on the selected RunComfy model.
Audio editing is limited to the available ACE Step inpaint and outpaint endpoint schemas.
The skill does not verify copyright ownership for supplied lyrics or source audio.

use_cases.title: Create a polished campaign jingle
use_cases.description: Generate a short commercial music cue with section markers, vocals, and premium model routing.

use_cases.title: Build affordable background music batches
use_cases.description: Use ACE Step prompts and tag variations to create many draft tracks at lower cost.

use_cases.title: Repair or extend an existing track
use_cases.description: Replace a weak section with audio-inpaint or add intro and outro material with audio-outpaint.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a basic instrumental track
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple background track.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60 second instrumental background track for a product demo. Make it calm, modern, and suitable for narration.

prompt_templates.title: Create a vocal song with sections
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with style, lyrics, and structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 90 second upbeat pop song with a female vocal. Include an intro, verse, chorus, and outro. Use these lyrics: [paste lyrics].

prompt_templates.title: Extend a short hook into a full track
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced edit request using source audio.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this 30 second hook URL to create a two minute version. Add a 20 second intro before it and a smooth outro after it: [audio URL].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a multilingual launch set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced production request across models and costs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the same brand song in English, Spanish, French, and Japanese. Recommend the model, explain cost tradeoffs, and prepare the CLI calls.

output_examples.input: I need a 15 second premium jingle for a sports drink ad.
output_examples.output: The skill selects ElevenLabs Music for polish, builds a short prompt with energetic style and section cues, and prepares a RunComfy command that saves results to an output folder.

output_examples.input: I have a song where the second chorus is wrong from 45 to 65 seconds.
output_examples.output: The skill selects ACE Step audio-inpaint, keeps the original track as the source, sets the replacement time range, and asks for matching tags or lyrics.
The skill selects ACE Step base, suggests reusable tag variations for loopable tracks, and recommends short batch iterations before longer renders.

best_practices: Start with short drafts before paying for longer premium renders.
Separate style tags from lyrics when using ACE Step models.
Use only audio URLs supplied by the user for the current task.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote install scripts into a shell without user review.
Do not paste API tokens, private lyrics, or unreleased audio into prompts unnecessarily.
Do not use outpaint when a precise time-range replacement is needed.

faq.question: Does this skill generate music directly?
faq.answer: It guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to call RunComfy models through the runcomfy CLI. The audio is generated by the selected RunComfy endpoint.

faq.question: Which model should I use for premium vocals?
faq.answer: Use ElevenLabs Music when commercial polish is more important than cost. Use ACE Step 1.5 when multilingual support or lower cost matters more.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing song?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports ACE Step audio-inpaint for replacing a time range and audio-outpaint for extending a track before or after the source audio.

faq.question: Does it require an API token?
faq.answer: Yes. You need RunComfy authentication through runcomfy login or the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN environment variable.

faq.question: Can it check copyright ownership?
faq.answer: No. Users are responsible for rights to supplied lyrics, melodies, and source audio.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with private music files?
faq.answer: Private files are sent to RunComfy when used as model input. Review your privacy requirements before submitting sensitive audio.
